lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately twelve vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a repeating grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits, with higher spatial density in the anterior-dorsal quadrant.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a discernible rectangular lattice pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features running along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient characterized by high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8 to 10 low-resolution, high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral silhouette of the first dorsal fin, arranged in a non-linear, sparse configuration.
